request.style: English, gospel, powerful female solo voice with backing choir, piano, organ, drums, bass guitar, uplifting and emotional mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I cried to you for help today
You answered and you healed me straight
You brought me up from deep below
Kept me alive from the pit's cold

[Verse]
You made my mountain stand so firm
In your favor, a new dawn
But when you hid your face from me
I was terrified on my knee

[Chorus]
His anger lasts only a moment
His favor lasts a lifetime long
Weeping may spend the night alone
But joy comes in the morning song

[Pre-Chorus]
Sing to the Lord, you faithful ones
Give thanks to his holy name
Do not forget the mercy shown
When we were lost in pain

[Chorus]
His anger lasts only a moment
His favor lasts a lifetime long
Weeping may spend the night alone
But joy comes in the morning song

[Bridge]
To you I called in my distress
To the Lord I pleaded for grace
He lifted me from the depths of death
And gave me a new lease of days

[Chorus]
His anger lasts only a moment
His favor lasts a lifetime long
Weeping may spend the night alone
But joy comes in the morning song

[Outro]
Joy comes in the morning
Joy comes in the morning
